name: 02021 · Canton, MA
findings: ZIP 02021 (Canton) has 124 nonprofit organizations. 51 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02021 (Canton) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 02021 (Canton) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 32 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
